banlist.intro: Banning certain cards aims to preserve the balance and integrity of the format. When a card generates excessive advantage, reduces interaction, or limits strategic diversity, it can harm the quality of games. Bans help maintain a healthy, competitive environment true to the format's spirit.
banlist.asCommanderDesc: The following cards are banned as commanders in Pauper Duel Commander, as their permanent access from the command zone creates an excessive advantage and harms the balance and diversity of the format.
banlist.inDeckDesc: The following cards are banned in the deck in Pauper Duel Commander, as their impact is deemed too powerful or too restrictive for the format, harming balance, interaction, and strategic diversity.
banlist.historyCadence: The committee publishes a format announcement every two months, on the first Monday of even months.

rulesDoc.title: Format Rules
rulesDoc.subtitle: The Pauper Duel Commander France ruleset: deck construction, rarities and game rules.

articles.text: Pauper Duel Commander France (PDC Fr) is a two-player (1vs1) Constructed Magic: The Gathering format.
Games of Pauper Duel Commander France are played using the Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules, except as modified by these rules.
Unless otherwise specified, games follow the Commander rules defined in the Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules.
For the purpose of these rules, card rarities are defined as follows (you can refer to Scryfall):

sub.text: A common card is a card that has been printed at common rarity in any legal paper or Magic Online printing.
An uncommon card is a card that has been printed at uncommon rarity in any legal paper or Magic Online printing.
A card may be both a common card and an uncommon card.

articles.text: A deck consists of exactly 100 cards, including its commander(s).
Except for basic lands, a deck may not contain more than one card with the same English name.
All cards in a deck must have a color identity contained within the color identity of its commander(s).
A commander must be an Uncommon Creature, Vehicle, Spacecraft or Background (when applicable).
Players may only cast one of their commanders from the command zone per game (the first one cast).
Every non-commander card in a deck must be a common card.
Cards appearing on the Pauper Duel Commander France banned list are not legal.
Any non-legal cards in Vintage are banned.
Each player begins the game with 20 life.
The starting player skips the draw step of their first turn.
A commander may be cast from the command zone. Commander tax applies as defined by the Commander rules.
